detailBlocks.heading: What this screen is
detailBlocks.body: The opening screen of the Bio Vera mobile app. It shows the brand and two main options: sign in for existing users and the path to register a new grower in the programme.

detailBlocks.heading: “Log in” button
detailBlocks.body: Use this if the team has already opened your account and you received access details. It leads to the email or username and password screen.

detailBlocks.heading: “Become a Vera grower”
detailBlocks.body: For new partners entering the programme for the first time. Opens the registration form. Registration usually follows guidance from the operations team — do not submit details without agreement.

detailBlocks.heading: Why it matters
detailBlocks.body: All work in the app starts here: field entries, input orders, lots, and sync with the web portal. Without signing in, no data is linked to your farm.

detailBlocks.heading: What this screen is
detailBlocks.body: Form to create a grower (farmer) account. The details you enter identify your farm in Bio Vera and support later verification by the team.

detailBlocks.heading: Form fields
detailBlocks.body:
First and last name — contact person on the farm.
Email — for sign-in and notifications; must be valid.
Hectares — approximate total cultivated area; an estimate is enough.
Password — minimum 6 characters; keep it private and do not share with other farms.

detailBlocks.heading: “Create account” button
detailBlocks.body: Sends the application to the server. If everything is correct, you receive confirmation; full app access often comes only after Bio Vera approves the account.

detailBlocks.heading: “Already have an account? Sign in”
detailBlocks.body: If you already registered, go back to sign in instead of registering again — duplicate accounts slow down the team’s work.

detailBlocks.heading: What this screen is
detailBlocks.body: Standard sign-in for existing users. You start here every day — without signing in you cannot enter field data or see orders and lots.

detailBlocks.heading: What to enter
detailBlocks.body:
Email or username — what you were given when the account was activated.
Password — the one you set at registration or that the team sent you.

detailBlocks.heading: Security
detailBlocks.body: The account is tied to one farm and one responsibility in the chain. Do not share the password with unauthorised workers; for field help follow team instructions, not a shared account.

detailBlocks.heading: If sign-in fails
detailBlocks.body: Check the network, email, and password. If it still fails, contact operations — the account may not be approved yet or the password may have been reset.

detailBlocks.heading: What this screen is
detailBlocks.body: Main dashboard after sign-in. Here you see what the system expects from you this season, whether data is waiting to upload, and shortcuts to important parts of the app.

detailBlocks.heading: “What’s next” / next step
detailBlocks.body: Card that leads to the current task in the programme (e.g. register a parcel, field entry, packing). Follow it in order — skipping steps can block later phases (lot, transport).

detailBlocks.heading: Sync (offline)
detailBlocks.body: If you worked offline, here you see how many entries are waiting to send. When the network is back, run sync and wait for confirmation — only then do entries enter the official production trail.

detailBlocks.heading: Shortcuts and notifications
detailBlocks.body: From here you open the wallet, instructions, team notifications, and other tabs (Field, Lots, Suppliers). Home is the hub — you do not need to do everything here, but check it once a day.

detailBlocks.heading: What the Field tab is
detailBlocks.body: Central place for everything on the farm before harvest: estates, parcels, plantings, growth journal, and field log (sowing, fertilising, crop protection). Most compliance evidence is created here.

detailBlocks.heading: My fields / estates
detailBlocks.body: Register the farm as a whole and see estates linked to your account. Without a registered estate and parcel, later GPS entries may be rejected.

detailBlocks.heading: Parcels and zones
detailBlocks.body: Draw or confirm parcel boundaries on the map (polygon). Enable drawing, choose Tap points or Finger, at least three points. While drawing keep the map still — use the location button to centre, not pull-to-refresh. GPS checks apply on field entries. “Pending approval” means operations have not confirmed the boundary yet.

detailBlocks.heading: My plantings
detailBlocks.body: For each parcel define crop, season, and harvest plan. Plantings link field entries to a specific crop — important for seed-to-goods traceability.

detailBlocks.heading: Growth journal and field log
detailBlocks.body:
Growth journal: periodic photos of crop development.
Field log: each significant action (sowing, fertilising, spraying) with photo, GPS coordinate and, where required, barcode scan from input packaging. Inputs must be on the whitelist — the system blocks unapproved products.

detailBlocks.heading: What the Lots tab is
detailBlocks.body: After harvest you move from “field” to “goods”: each batch (lot) gets an identity in the system — status, quality, packaging, and link to transport.

detailBlocks.heading: Lot list and statuses
detailBlocks.body: See all batches and where they are in the process: preparing, packed, at hub, in transit, delivered. Status colour or label helps avoid sending the same goods twice.

detailBlocks.heading: Quality and packaging compliance
detailBlocks.body: Enter or attach quality and packaging photos per Bio Vera programme rules. Non-compliant packaging can reduce bonus or block dispatch.

detailBlocks.heading: Transport
detailBlocks.body: When the lot is ready and documented, submit a transport request. Driver and hub see the lot in their part of the app — you do not finish until goods are collected and scanned at the next stage.

detailBlocks.heading: What this part of the app is
detailBlocks.body: Order approved inputs (seed, packaging, batch ID) from Vera partners on the map. An in-app order links to later field entries and traceability.

detailBlocks.heading: Suppliers map
detailBlocks.body: Shows partners nearby. Choose a supplier, view the offer, and start an order. Use programme products only — off-list products risk entry blocks.

detailBlocks.heading: Orders tab
detailBlocks.body: Track each order: ordered, preparing, dispatched, received at farm. When goods arrive, confirm receipt in the app — that closes the loop for audit.

detailBlocks.heading: Messages tab
detailBlocks.body: Chat with the supplier about deadlines, delivery, or product codes. Messages are separate from the order list — you do not open an order through chat.

detailBlocks.heading: What the profile screen is
detailBlocks.body: Personal and business details for your account: farm name, contact, partner code, language, and notifications. Sign out here on devices you no longer use.

detailBlocks.heading: Farm details
detailBlocks.body: Check that farm name, address, and partner code are correct — errors complicate payouts and team communication. Contact operations for changes if a field is not editable.

detailBlocks.heading: Notifications and security
detailBlocks.body: Enable notifications for orders, parcel approvals, and messages. Always sign out on shared phones or tablets on the farm.

detailBlocks.heading: What the wallet is
detailBlocks.body: Financial overview of your production in Bio Vera: amounts in escrow (awaiting payout conditions), available balance, and history by lot or order.

detailBlocks.heading: Escrow and available
detailBlocks.body:
Escrow: amount reserved until conditions are met (e.g. delivery confirmation, quality).
Available: amount you can expect in payout per programme rules. Phone figures should match the web dashboard — if not, sync and contact the team.

detailBlocks.heading: When to check
detailBlocks.body: After closing a lot, buyer receipt, and at month end. The wallet is not a substitute for contract — written Bio Vera rules still apply for agreements and claims.
